description: Get logs for a Code Engine application. Retrieves logs from all running pods (or a specific instance) via the Code Engine Kubernetes API proxy.

instance_name.description: Optional: specific pod/instance name to filter to (e.g. my-app-00001-deployment-abcde). If omitted, logs from all pods are returned.

tail_lines.description: Number of log lines to return per pod (default: 100)

name: ce_get_app_logs
